dct_description_sm:
A site which has the potential to be used for hydroelectric power generation. This data set was created using information identified in the 1985 Ontario's Waterpower Sites publication. The information assembled combined the effort of the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Energy and at the time Ontario Hydro.

Additional Time Period Information: Data is collected on an on-going basis therefore the time period 'end date' may be more recent than indicated above.
